concepts.why: Secular scholar / Lutheran / Reformed: James 2:10 says nothing of a blessing or a curse (it speaks of guilt in breaking the whole law), so under 'A blessing and a curse' it merely shares the subject of keeping the law; the neighbouring Galatians 3:10 and Deuteronomy 27:26 carry the curse. Drop it, or move it to 'The law and sin'.

Baptist/dispensational, Jewish-reader and Catholic/Orthodox: 2 Corinthians 3:3 is not a promise but a statement that the Corinthians are already 'a letter from Christ'; set among Deuteronomy 30:6, Jeremiah 31, Ezekiel 11 and 36 it takes a side on whether the promise to Israel is realised in the church. The concept is meant to be the theme's own words of hope, all promises. Hebrews 8:10 may stay because it quotes Jeremiah 31 in so many words ('the house of Israel').
